summary: Fixed 2 structural bugs in the mooter-continuous-tester feedback loop: meta-prompt leakage into classification data, and empty A/B matchup names when a model errored. Added defensive filters on the review side so stale/malformed historical events don't pollute gold-label exports. Verified with full-report regression (stale meta-prompt count 70+ → 0 after filters).

bugs_fixed.title: Meta-prompt leak
bugs_fixed.symptom: Generator instructions ("Each prompt must...", "Focus:", "We are focusing on...", "- Use one of...") were logged as test prompts and flagged as misroutings with expected_tier=null, producing ~90 stale entries in decisions.log.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: META_PROMPT_FILTER regex only caught 6 narrow prefixes (Thinking, We are generating, Mix languages, One prompt per line, Realistic for a developer, - Mix/Realistic/One prompt). Did not match common generator lingo like 'Each prompt must', 'Focus:', 'Prompt N:', bullet-skill patterns.
bugs_fixed.fix: Expanded META_PROMPT_START regex to ~25 prefixes including 'Each prompt must', 'Focus:', 'Prompt N:', 'Use one of', 'They must', 'Rules:', 'Requirements:', '- model-X:' skill-name patterns. Added META_PROMPT_CONTAINS for in-body phrases ('specialist skills', 'per prompt', 'one of the specialist').

bugs_fixed.title: A/B matchup empty names
bugs_fixed.symptom: 44 A/B tests in the previous delta window showed matchup " vs " (empty model names), all TIE:44. Masquerading as real ties, polluting win-rate statistics.
bugs_fixed.root_cause: runABTest returns {winner:null, reason:'one_model_failed'} on model error WITHOUT model_a/model_b fields. logEvent spreads this incomplete object, producing events with undefined model_a/model_b. mooter-review then joins undefined values to produce empty matchup names, and the winner:null path falls through to TIE in the pairStats counter.
bugs_fixed.fix: (a) runABTest now returns model_a, model_b, category, prompt_preview, latencies, and error snippets even on failure. (b) mooter-review skips events where model_a or model_b is falsy, AND treats winner==null as a failed test (not a TIE), excluding from matchup stats entirely.

defensive_filters_added: mooter-review.js: skip misroutings where expected_tier is null (stale pre-fix log entries).
mooter-review.js: apply same META_PROMPT regex when reading tester_misrouting events, so historical stale data cannot leak into gold-label exports.

full_report_regression.note: The remaining 47 are real classifier misroutings from PROMPT_TEMPLATES (e.g., 'how should we handle X in our Y?' expected T2 got T0). These are classifier improvement targets, not harness bugs.

strengths: Delta-watermark review avoids stale repeat suggestions.
Veto mechanism for user-rated-good patterns prevents backwards overfits.

gaps_to_close.title: No positional swap in judge calls
gaps_to_close.impact: ~30% of judge verdicts flip when A/B positions are swapped. Current single-pass judgment has unmitigated positional bias.

gaps_to_close.title: Template-based prompt generation has coverage blind spots
gaps_to_close.fix_idea: Bootstrap 10% of each batch from decisions.log real-traffic samples.

gaps_to_close.title: Pattern-weight adjustments not calibrated
gaps_to_close.fix_idea: Add exponential decay over time and minimum-sample threshold (n ≥ 20) before demotion.

gaps_to_close.title: No confidence intervals on win-rate
gaps_to_close.fix_idea: Wilson score interval would surface whether 55% win rate is meaningfully different from 50%.

gaps_to_close.title: Human review gate is synchronous
gaps_to_close.fix_idea: Automated staleness alert when >72h since last review with >N new misroutings.

literature_aligned: Sculley et al. (Hidden Technical Debt in ML Systems)

classifier_unchanged.note: This session touches ONLY the harness (tester + review). classify.js and patterns.js are byte-for-byte identical to v0.9.9+review2. validate-set.js --strict currently fails at 80% overall / 90% canonical — this is a pre-existing state, not caused by this session. Tuning from backtest was NOT applied (would require accuracy recovery first).

next_session_candidates: Implement judge positional-swap (GAP-1) — highest-impact best-practice fix.
Bootstrap real-traffic samples into prompt generation (GAP-2).
Investigate 47 real classifier misroutings remaining in full review.
Fix validate-set.js --strict failures so future tuning can be applied.
